videos.title: North/South Strangle - Finishing With 2 Hands by John Danaher
videos.whyUseful: Danaher breaks the finish down to the hand position and the way the space closes, which is the part most people get wrong after they have the position.

videos.title: North South Choke As A Pinning Tool by Craig Jones
videos.whyUseful: Shows the choke used as control rather than only as a finish, which is the idea behind keeping the choke shape on while you wait for the reaction.

videos.title: The North South Choke in 1 Minute and 55 Seconds.
videos.whyUseful: A short no-gi breakdown of the setup and the finish, useful as the first pass before drilling the position.
